title.en: Multiple states and AI groups publish the Paris Call for AI safety and security
title.zhHans: 多国与 AI 机构公布《巴黎 AI 安全与安保倡议》

searchSummary.en: France and Canada published a multi-stakeholder Paris Call for AI safety and security, signed by states, AI companies and civil society groups on November 9.
searchSummary.zhHans: 法国和加拿大公布多方参与的《巴黎 AI 安全与安保倡议》，多国、AI 企业和民间团体于 11 月 9 日签署。

summary.en: On November 9, France and Canada published a multi-stakeholder Paris Call for AI safety and security, signed by states, AI companies and civil society groups on November 9.
summary.zhHans: 11 月 9 日，法国和加拿大公布多方参与的《巴黎 AI 安全与安保倡议》，多国、AI 企业和民间团体于 11 月 9 日签署。

narrative.en: The voluntary declaration calls for risk-evaluation frameworks, lifecycle accountability and fail-safes, and incident reporting with whistleblower channels. It is not a new law or proof that any signatory implemented or audited the commitments. Signatory totals on the two official pages may differ as endorsements continue; no stable total is asserted here.
narrative.zhHans: 这份自愿声明倡议风险评估框架、全生命周期问责及故障安全机制，并提出事件报告与举报渠道。它不是新法律，也不能证明签署方已经落实或审计承诺。随着继续接受联署，两处官网的签署方数量可能不同；本条不主张固定总数。
